meta.name: frontend
meta.description: Frontend development standards for React, TailwindCSS, and Vite. Use for UI components, pages, styling, and frontend architecture. Covers component patterns, state management, and performance.

copy.tagline: 遵循标准模式构建React前端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用React开发前端，希望有规范的组件与架构模式。
copy.tagline_en: Build React frontends with standard patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop React frontends and need clear standards for components and architecture.

howto.what: 写 React/Tailwind/Vite 前端时遵守既定规范:每个组件一个文件且≤200行,输入属性标明类型;获取数据用现成 hook,界面状态用本地变量;样式统一用主题颜色,并做性能和无障碍处理。
howto.when: 当你要开发或修改 React/Tailwind/Vite 的界面组件、页面、样式等前端需求时触发。

howto.what_en: Follows React/Tailwind/Vite frontend conventions: one component per file, max 200 lines, typed props; server data via hooks, local UI state; styles use theme tokens; adds performance and accessibility handling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or modify React/Tailwind/Vite UI components, pages, styling, or frontend architecture. Often chains with quality and lint-fixer skills.
